dialog.english:
I thought maybe we should get some
food.
dialog.translation:
He pensado que deberíamos buscar
comida.

dialog.english:
I'm stuck using a twig for bait.
I'm hoping fish will mistake it
for a worm.
dialog.translation:
Uso una ramita como cebo, a ver
si algún pez la confunde con un
gusano.

dialog.english:
This is why I *said* I didn't want
to go to camp.
dialog.translation:
Por esto dije que NO quería ir al
campamento.

dialog.english:
You can tell me that all you want,
but I can't do much about it.
dialog.translation:
Puedes decir todo lo que quieras,
no puedo hacer nada.

dialog.english:
Who else do I say it to, then?
We're the only ones here!
dialog.translation:
¿A quién se lo digo si no?
¡Somos los únicos aquí!

dialog.english:
Yeah, but if we're gonna drift
around, we should have a bit more
optimism about it.
dialog.translation:
Sí, pero si vamos a seguir
deambulando, deberíamos ser algo
más optimistas.

dialog.english:
How are we supposed to have a bit
more optimism?!
...Ah...ughhhh...
dialog.translation:
¡¿Cómo vamos a ser algo más
optimistas?!
...¡Ah!... uhhh...

dialog.english:
Can't really call this
seasickness. Maybe bedsickness?
dialog.translation:
¿Uno suele marearse en un
barco... pero en una cama?

dialog.english:
What does seasickness have to do
with optimism...Hm? A box!
dialog.translation:
¿Qué tiene que ver el mareo con el
optimismo...? ¿Eh? ¡Una caja!

dialog.english:
Maybe it's got something to eat!
Like canned food, or rations.
dialog.translation:
¡Quizás tenga comida, algo en
lata, o raciones!

dialog.english:
Sorry, I'm not food! I'm gonna
beat you, Chosen Children!
dialog.translation:
¡Lamento no ser comida! ¡Os daré
una paliza, Niños Elegidos!

dialog.english:
We can't run away! All this bed
shaking is making me sick!
dialog.translation:
¡No podemos escapar! ¡El movimiento
de la cama me marea!

dialog.english:
Attacking at a time like this?
You're playing dirty!

Shut up! Take this!
Fist of the Tyrant!

We managed to get away...and when
I thought it was all over, your
fishing line appeared.
dialog.translation:
Conseguimos largarnos... y cuando
pensé que ya no había esperanza,
apareció tu sedal.

dialog.english:
We didn't catch any fish, but I'm
glad it worked out.
dialog.translation:
No pescamos nada, pero me alegro
de que sirviese.

dialog.english: So, I have a favor to ask.

It's about Joe. He's completely
lost his nerve.
dialog.translation:
Es sobre Joe. Ha perdido el valor
del todo.
Nunca fue muy seguro de sí.

dialog.english:
We can't have an adventure like
this, so let's make him leader to
give him some confidence.
dialog.translation:
No podemos tener una aventura
así, lo podemos hacer líder para
darle confianza.

dialog.english:
That's why we're making you leader
from now on!
dialog.translation:
¡Por eso serás el líder a
partir de ahora!

dialog.english:
You're the only one who can do it,
Joe!
dialog.translation: ¡Sólo tú puedes ser el líder, Joe!

dialog.english:
Is that to celebrate me becoming
leader?
dialog.translation:
¿Es para celebrar que soy el
líder?

dialog.english:
Maybe this time there'll be humans
inside!

Wait! Joe is the leader! What
should we do, Leader?
dialog.translation:
¡Espera! ¡Joe es el líder! ¿Qué
debemos hacer, líder?

dialog.english:
Okay! Maybe we'll finally see
other humans in that church!
dialog.translation:
¡Vale! ¡Quizás veamos más humanos
en esta iglesia!

dialog.english:
You're still saying that. It'd be
convenient if there were, but...
dialog.translation:
Sigues con esas... Sería práctico
que fuese así, pero...

dialog.english: He's become more of a leader!

Excuse me, what kind of dance is
this?

This is a carnival where we make
offerings to the Great Bakemon!
dialog.translation:
¡Es un carnaval donde hacemos
ofrendas al Gran Bakemon!

dialog.english:
The Great Bakemon is the Great
Bakemon!
dialog.translation:
¡El Gran Bakemon es el Gran
Bakemon!

dialog.english:
Would you also like to leave
offerings to the Great Bakemon?
dialog.translation:
¿Quieres dejar ofrendas para el
Gran Bakemon?

dialog.english:
I know about Bakemon! They're
ghost Digimon who live in the
Overdell Graveyard, but...
dialog.translation:
¡Conozco a Bakemon! Son Digimon
fantasma, del Cementerio
Overdel, pero...

dialog.english:
...They're not exactly a Digimon
you'd want to leave offerings to.
dialog.translation:
...No son la clase de Digimon a
quien le darías ofrendas.

dialog.english:
God does not tolerate those who
speak ill of the Great Bakemon!
dialog.translation:
¡Dios no tolera a aquellos que
hablan mal del Gran Bakemon!

dialog.english:
We are lucky to have guests come
on our day of carnival.
dialog.translation:
Tenemos suerte de tener invitados
en nuestro carnaval.

dialog.english:
We're lucky to have ended up on
this island!

Joe, there's something really
suspicious about these people.
dialog.translation:
Joe, hay algo muy sospechoso
en esta gente.

dialog.english:
Have any other children besides us
come here?

I see. I wonder where everyone
else is...
dialog.translation:
Ya veo. Me pregunto dónde están
todos...

dialog.english:
More importantly, want to come
dance for the Great Bakemon with
us?
dialog.translation:
Y lo más importante, ¿bailaréis
para el Gran Bakemon con
nosotros?

dialog.english:
We've come from Tokyo, and we need
to get back.
dialog.translation:
Venimos de Tokio, y tenemos que
volver.

dialog.english:
That seems like a problem. Please
do stay in this church as long as
you like.
dialog.translation:
Parece un problema. Por favor,
quedaos en la iglesia tanto como
queráis.

dialog.english: No, I mean we *want* to get back!

Looks like we're not going to get
anywhere...
dialog.translation:
Parece que no vamos a conseguir
nada...

dialog.english:
Luckily, we have obtained our
offerings for today.
dialog.translation:
Por suerte, tenemos nuestras
ofrendas del día.

dialog.english:
Where's the offering? I can't see
it.
Good, you're up. I was worried...

Where are we? Where are Joe and
Gomamon?

I think they're probably in
another jail cell in the basement.
dialog.translation:
Probablemente estén en otra
celda en el sótano.

dialog.english:
We've got to find a way to get out
of here and meet up with Joe and
Gomamon...
dialog.translation:
Tenemos que hallar un modo de
salir de aquí y encontrar a Joe
y Gomamon...

dialog.english:
I feel a bit of air. I think
there's a gap in the wall
somewhere around here.
dialog.translation:
Noto algo de aire. Creo que hay
un hueco aquí en la pared, en
algún lado.

dialog.english:
The floor, ceiling, and walls all
look kind of unstable.
dialog.translation:
El suelo, techo y pared parecen
inestables.

dialog.english:
There's a hole! It's small, but it
looks like we can squeeze through.
dialog.translation:
¡Hay un agujero! Es pequeño pero
parece que podríamos caber.

dialog.english:
Looks like it's a bit too small
for me.

All right. In that case, you wait
here and I'll open the door from
the outside!
dialog.translation:
Vale. ¡En ese caso, espera aquí y
abriré la puerta desde el
exterior!

dialog.english:
Okay, but be careful! There are
Bakemon guards outside keeping
watch.
dialog.translation:
¡Vale, pero ten cuidado! Hay
guardas Bakemon fuera
vigilando.

dialog.english:
Thanks! I'll make it back for
sure.

Nunu! The offerings are running
away!!

Sorry, it looks like they found
me...

Stop trying to escape. Sit down
and be quiet like good offerings!
dialog.translation:
¡Permaneced quietos y en silencio
como buenas ofrendas!

dialog.english:
Looks like they haven't noticed
the hole in the cell...
dialog.translation:
Parece que no se fijaron en el
agujero en la pared...

dialog.english:
I plugged it after you went out!
They didn't notice it at all.
dialog.translation:
¡Lo cerré cuando saliste! No se
han dado ni cuenta.

dialog.english: All right, I'm gonna try again.
Yeah, I'll do it this time!

(They're keeping a close watch.
Doesn't seem like I can get
through there...)
dialog.translation:
(Vigilan fijamente. No parece que
pueda ir por ahí...)

dialog.english: Hey, you look kind of pale.

Can't you see I haven't been
sleeping well lately?
dialog.translation:
¿No ves que no he pegado ojo
últimamente?

dialog.english:
(Looks like I can't get through
without Piyomon...)
dialog.translation:
(Parece que no puedo pasar sin
Piyomon...)

dialog.english:
I really should have studied at
home instead of going to camp...
dialog.translation:
Debería haberme quedado
estudiando en vez de ir al
campamento...

dialog.english:
You're making too much noise! Be
quiet.

(Joe's safe...but I can't defeat
those guards without getting
Piyomon out.)
dialog.translation:
(Joe está a salvo, pero no puedo
vencer a los guardias sin sacar
a Piyomon.)

dialog.english:
Thanks, Sora! Let's hurry up and
get out of here.

We have to get Joe and Gomamon out
first!
dialog.translation:
¡Tenemos que sacar a Joe y Gomamon
primero!

dialog.english:
Unu! The offerings are running
away!

It won't be so easy to catch us
this time!

If we go out this way, we'll be
able to escape.
dialog.translation:
Si vamos por aquí, podremos
escapar.

dialog.english:
We have to get Joe and Gomamon out
first!
dialog.translation:
¡Tenemos que sacar a Joe y Gomamon
primero!

dialog.english:
Right...let's find out where the
Bakemon are holding them!
dialog.translation:
Cierto... Busquemos dónde los
retienen los Bakemon.

dialog.english:
Sora! We can't abandon Joe and
Gomamon!
dialog.translation:
¡No podemos abandonar a Joe
y Gomamon!

dialog.english:
L-let go of me! If you eat me,
I'll taste bad! Let go!

That's not a problem, what we need
is your soul!
dialog.translation:
¡No es un problema, queremos tu
alma!

dialog.english:
Are you saying someone else has a
better-tasting soul?
dialog.translation:
¿Dices que sabes de almas que
tienen mejor sabor?

dialog.english:
Joe, is this how a leader should
act? You over there, let go
of them!
dialog.translation:
Joe, ¿así es como se comporta un
líder? Tú, ¡déjalos!

dialog.english:
Idiots! All you've done is save us
time taking you out of the prison!
dialog.translation:
¡Idiotas! ¡Solo nos habéis
ahorrado el trabajo de
sacaros de la celda!

dialog.english:
You're a hundred years too early
to make me your offering!
dialog.translation:
¡Te faltan cien años para
convertirme en tu ofrenda!

dialog.english:
My luck is terrible, I didn't
think that going to camp would
make all this happen...
dialog.translation:
Odio mi suerte. No pensé que ir
al campamento haría que pasase
todo esto...

dialog.english:
Pull yourself together, Joe!
You're the leader right now!

Let's run for it before they find
us!
dialog.translation: Hay que irse o nos encontrarán.

dialog.english:
?! But the prison had guards
posted in front!

Unfortunately for you, we've
defeated them!
dialog.translation:
¡Por desgracia para ti, los hemos
derrotado!

dialog.english:
W-we did it, now let's get out of
here!
It'll be easy from now on! Easy!
It'll be easy from now on! Easy!

We should hurry, before they catch
us!

What do we do, Sora? We're
surrounded!

You've made a big mistake in
thinking you could escape. Your
souls will be delicious!
dialog.translation:
Cometisteis un error pensando que
podríais escapar. ¡Vuestras almas
estarán deliciosas!

dialog.english:
We're preparing the salt and
pepper!

We're preparing the salt and
pepper!

The best souls are prepared by
scaring them thoroughly!
dialog.translation:
¡Las mejores almas son las que
están aterradas!

dialog.english: They fused into a giant one!
They fused into a giant one!

It's a ghost, so attacks don't
work!
dialog.translation:
¡Es un fantasma, no le podemos
tocar!

dialog.english:
It's a ghost, so attacks don't
work!
dialog.translation:
¡Es un fantasma, no le podemos
tocar!

dialog.english:
A ghost...the only thing that'll
work is a sutra asking for God's
divine grace!
dialog.translation:
Un fantasma... ¡Los textos
sagrados pueden usarse contra los
fantasmas!

dialog.english:
My grandma from the country gave
me one so I could do well on
tests.
dialog.translation:
¡Mi abuela me los enseñaba en
el pueblo para ayudarme
en los exámenes!

dialog.english:
Gnis selb taergst niop llufst niop
derd nuh...
dialog.translation:
Buda grande y poderoso yo te
imploro...

dialog.english:
Gnis selb taergst niop llufst niop
derd nuh...
dialog.translation:
Buda grande y poderoso yo te
imploro...

dialog.english:
Okay, now! Gomamon, Piyomon! It's
your turn!

Okay, now! Gomamon, Piyomon! It's
your turn!

I don't know how we did it, but we
won!

Maybe everyone else made it back
there!

(I can't get caught by the guards,
I have to get Piyomon out of the
prison...)
dialog.translation:
(No puedo dejar que me cojan los
guardias, tengo que sacar a
Piyomon...)
